 “ Slow Horses ” is set to return for two more seasons.
 Although speculation has intensified that the show will call it quits after Season 8, which is currently shooting in London, Apple TV dispelled those rumors by confirming it will return.
 Aside from Gary Oldman , the streamer did not confirm which of the cast would be returning – particularly Jack Lowden , who plays River Cartwright, and was widely speculated to be Amazon’s top choice to play James Bond. (A few hours after publishing this story, Robert Pattinson was confirmed as Amazon MGM’s new 007).

 Olivia Cooke, whose character Sid Baker was thought to have been killed off at the end of Season 1 before returning from the dead in Season 6, said she believed she was shooting the last season . Photos of her on set with Lowden shooting Season 8 around London have been circulating for the past few months.
 “I am shooting the last season!” she told The Times of London. “Never say never. But I think that’s what we’ve been told and it definitely feels like we are ending. We’re all melancholy, distracted. Yesterday, I got in the make-up chair and cried.”
 Season 7 has already been filmed.
 “Slow Horses” has been one of Apple TV’s biggest hits since launching in 2022. Based on the books by Mick Herron, it follows a band of MI5 misfits who’ve each been relegated to Slough House, a unit for disgraced agents led by the irascible Jackson Lamb (Oldman).
 It stars Kristin Scott Thomas as MI5 boss Diana Taverner, Saskia Reeves as Catherine Standish, Christopher Chung as Roddy Ho, Rosalind Eleazar as Louisa Guy and Aimee-Ffion Edwards as Shirley Dander. Recurring stars include Hugo Weaving as Frank Harkness, Joanna Scanlan as Moira Tregorian and Jonathan Pryce as David Cartwright.
